news.title: Anthropic's Amodei says China presents 'toughest dilemma' for his proposed AI slowdown
news.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Demis Hassabis, the chair of Google DeepMind, and Elon Musk have all welcomed Amodei's proposal.

news.title: Washington scrambles to meet calls for AI guardrails while the window to act closes
news.description: The House is scheduled to be sent home in the coming days until after November's midterm elections, leaving a narrow window to pass any form of AI regulation.

news.title: Vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says, as prospects for U.S.-Iran diplomacy appear elusive
news.description: The latest strike happened ahead of an expected meeting between Iranian and Gulf officials in Oman to sign an agreement for shipping through the strait.

news.title: NFL and midterm elections set up prediction markets for a critical fall season
news.description: The 2025 football season and 2024 presidential election pushed prediction markets into the prominence they enjoy today.

news.title: Larry Ellison nixes plan to offload up to $7.5 billion worth of Oracle stock
news.description: Oracle founder Larry Ellison has canceled his plan to sell up to $7.5 billion worth of stock in the software company.

news.title: Goldman picks China healthcare stocks for a post-AI trade
news.description: Chinese stocks' earnings tracked by Goldman Sachs grew at their highest quarterly pace in five years.

news.title: China's Xi urges BRICS nations to work towards peace in the Middle East
news.description: China, Iran's biggest trading partner and a key customer of Tehran's energy exports, is willing to work with BRICS towards peace in the region, Xi said.

news.title: Russia, Trump and a battle over welfare loom over Sweden’s election
news.description: Russia's war, permanently higher defense spending and uncertainty over U.S. commitments are narrowing the choices facing whoever wins Sunday's election.

news.title: Xi says China will take lead to foster AI, tech cooperation among BRICS countries
news.description: China will take the lead to help foster artificial-intelligence collaboration and development among developing-economy countries, President Xi Jinping said.

news.title: GM plans U.S. battery development as Trump's DOT attacks Ford for China ties
news.description: Most battery cells currently rely on raw materials from China. GM is seeking to establish domestic supply chains both for EVs and energy storage.

news.title: Why data centers could be the next big market for catastrophe bonds
news.description: CAT bonds, or catastrophe bonds, could bring data center risk to capital markets, with the first dedicated deal potentially emerging within 12 to 18 months.

news.title: Oracle's Larry Ellison adopts trading plan to sell up to $7.5 billion worth of stock
news.description: Oracle founder Larry Ellison, the world's seventh-richest person, can sell up to 50 million of his shares in the software company under a new trading plan.

news.title: Altimeter's Gerstner blasts researchers voicing AI extinction warnings, questions 'political agenda'
news.description: Brad Gerstner responded to the flurry of AI stories this week after a researcher quit his job at Anthropic, accusing AI companies of "gambling with our lives."

news.title: Dell stock jumps on RBC initiation, now up nearly 350% in 2026
news.description: Dell sold about $16.4 billion of AI servers in its second quarter, RBC said.

news.title: Inflation is outpacing wage growth again, squeezing Americans’ paychecks
news.description: In August, consumer prices rose 3.4% over the past year while wages increased just 3.1%.

news.title: Consumer outlook plunges in September as inflation outlook worsens
news.description: The survey's headline index hit a level of 47.8, down 7.5% from the August reading and off 13.2% from a year ago.

news.title: Record U.S. cyclosporiasis outbreak is over, CDC says
news.description: The largest outbreak, linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms, sickened more than 12,000 people.

news.title: Inflation persisted in August, potentially locking in a Fed interest rate hike
news.description: The all-items consumer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, with core, excluding food and energy, showing a 0.2% gain, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

news.title: Friday's CPI inflation report is even more important than usual. Here's what to expect
news.description: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the August consumer price index report at 8:30 a.m.

news.title: The likelihood of a Fed interest rate hike next week just got a lot higher
news.description: Traders pushed chances for a rate increase to 70% in morning action.

news.title: The wages of American workers are under pressure. AI's potential role is drawing more attention
news.description: Wage growth for workers has slowed and is struggling to keep up with inflation, drawing attention to AI's potential role even as evidence remains incomplete.

news.title: OpenAI rules out IPO this year as Altman, Musk & Amodei warn AI is moving too fast
news.description: Altman's IPO comments and Amodei's public call for more careful pacing of AI development cap a week of loud AI warnings.
